theme.name: Alien Tech Void
theme.description: A high-speed, command-center mobile app designed for MEV searchers and crypto snipers. Uses deep void blacks, toxic purples, and acid greens. The UI should feel like illegal, highly-advanced alien technology. No soft shadows, rely on 1px glowing borders.

ScoreRing.description: Circular SVG progress indicator used in the Safety Audit View. Colored Acid Green if safe (>80), Yellow if warning (50-80), Red if scam (<50).

DashboardHome.layout: Grid of metrics at the top (SOL Balance, Win Rate). A massive centralized start/stop button designed like an alien reactor core. Bot status badge.

LiveScannerFeed.layout: Vertical FlatList of incoming tokens. High frequency updates. Each row is a tight, dense card.

TokenSafetyAudit.layout: Deep dive into a single token. Massive radial score chart at the top. 7-point checklist below with success/fail icons.

PortfolioTracker.layout: Split view: Open Positions (active radar/pulse animations) vs Closed Trades. Massive P&L metric in the header.

BotConfiguration.layout: Form-heavy scrolling view. Alien-styled toggles (track components), custom sliders for slippage, segmented controls for strategy presets.

ActivityLog.layout: Full screen terminal view. Pure black background. Monospace font only. Auto-scrolls to bottom.

icons.strategy: Use sharp, geometric icons where possible. Radar, Crosshair, Zap, Activity, ShieldAlert, Cpu.

media.description: Used as an absolute-positioned background in the Dashboard header or Configuration screen, with a heavy opacity overlay (e.g., bg-black/80 equivalent in React Native).
Used as the core bot identity in the Dashboard reactor button or header.
Subtle dark matter noise texture. Can be used as a tiled ImageBackground for HUD cards with low opacity (0.1).

accessibility_and_testing.testing_rule: Every interactive element (TouchableOpacity, Pressable, Switch, TextInput) MUST include a testID attribute (which maps to data-testid requirement) to facilitate robust automated testing.

react_native_rules.styling: MUST use StyleSheet.create(). NO HTML elements (div, span). NO Tailwind classNames.
react_native_rules.layout: Rely entirely on Flexbox (flexDirection, alignItems, justifyContent).
react_native_rules.shadows: Use React Native shadow properties (shadowColor, shadowOffset, shadowOpacity, shadowRadius) for iOS, and elevation for Android. Maps to primary or success colors for 'neon glow' effect.
react_native_rules.gradients: If gradients are needed, use expo-linear-gradient. Colors: ['#0D0814', '#1A1025'].
